title: Golden Cross
caption:
Why do headlines get excited about a golden cross?

It's when a fast moving average crosses above a slow one, suggesting the trend may be turning up. A death cross is the opposite.

But both arrive after much of the move has happened. They confirm a trend, they don't predict one.
